items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They took a grade that when Joanie was in the intermediate school, and moved it over to the high school.

ctx.x: No, not necessarily. Maybe that’s what was there. You know, I don’t know if I was drawn to it, I can’t tell you that. But I know I played it, you know. I couldn’t tell you a thing about it right now. I could tell you more about the bass than the clarinet, you know. But the bass part started in high school. You see what happened was, they took a grade – what did they do different? They took a grade that when Joanie was in the intermediate school, and moved it over to the high school. So I went to high school the…
So all along this time while you were playing the clarinet, you were coming through all these experiences, you were – still were developing the piano.
